title: Roberts and Latin material at private parties
summary: Roberts played Latin items at society parties.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: That was a good one. What about -- did you ever play any Latin material? Did he ever play any -- of course, I know earlier on he wrote some jazz tangos.
He played that kind of material?

He played some of that in some of those parties. He used to fill in whatever you wanted around, you know what I mean? Fill in, he used to get a kick out of it. He used to get a kick out of me doing -- he'd improvise around.
So he wasn't a very rigid -- he wasn't very rigid with his --

No, no, no, no, because everything was (unintelligible) than anything else. And the people he was catering to, the people were so well-managed, whatever he was doing, and they requested this and that and this and that. And somehow or other, he had a way to preach to these people. That was his claim, anyhow.
So he played, what, the Park Avenue type of sound?
Yeah, private parties, private homes and things like that, you know what I mean. The wealthy people, you can tell.
